# moddotplot-rs v0.6.2

**Note:** This file was generated by ChatGPT 5.6 Sol under the direction of Adam Phillippy.

v0.6.2 is an export and presentation usability patch. It remains a functional preview
and does not change the production estimator, scientific configurations, configuration
digests, or accuracy contract preserved by v0.6.1.

## Sequence identity

FASTA headers are split at the first whitespace. Axis labels may show the identifier
and description, while selectors and numeric output use only the identifier. Selectors
and filenames add the source-file stem and a numeric suffix when needed to distinguish
otherwise identical records.

## Data export

BEDPE and CSV omit zero-valued and missing cells. BEDPE remains the default and keeps
its conventional interval-pair fields plus `ANI_c`, direction, and direction support.
CSV is reduced to nine scientific columns: sequence IDs, interval pairs, `ANI_c`,
direction, and direction support. Exact formulas and column semantics are retained in
the new data-export format reference.

The native Save As picker contains format selection and is asked to start in Downloads.
After it returns, a modal reports preparation, rendering, and write progress until the
save completes. Complete cached detailed/exact viewports bypass another worker request.

## Image export and presentation

PNG, SVG, and PDF include axes, sequence labels, visible tracks, and a non-occluding
legend. SVG/PDF keep those components vectorized around an embedded raster heatmap.
Illustrator-compatible SVG image links and corrected PDF Y-axis text placement improve
portability.

The heatmap legend uses a linear `ANI_c` axis with six evenly spaced ticks while its
colors retain the adjustable minimum/midpoint/maximum transfer. Viridis on black is the
initial plot style. Loading and empty areas retain the application paper color, with
black confined to rendered tile bounds. Image pixels are rendered into an offscreen
framebuffer without resizing or repainting the visible plot.

See the [validation record](v0.6.2/VALIDATION.md) for release qualification.
